Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de componente pentru industria aviatică și aerospațială și Fabricația de produse pentru apărare și domeniul spațial
Location: Bucharest, Romania
This role is part of a large-scale SAP ECC6 to S/4HANA migration program for a major international organization. As a core member of a dedicated Data Migration Squad, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the transformation and loading pipelines that sit at the heart of the migration
delivery.
You will work closely with the Technical Lead and your fellow data engineers to ensure that data flows reliably, accurately, and on time from the source ECC6 environment to the target S/4HANA platform.
 WHO ARE YOU?
 You have solid hands-on experience designing and building ETL pipelines in complex data environments?
You are comfortable working with large volumes of heterogeneous data, and you know how to handle edge cases, rejections, and transformation complexity?
You are rigorous and detail-oriented — you care about the quality of what you deliver, not just whether it runs?
You enjoy working in a team, sharing knowledge, and improving practices collectively?
You are curious about SAP data landscapes, or already have some exposure to them?
Then this role is made for you.
 What We Can Achieve Together
 You will join a dedicated squad of 4 data professionals, embedded within a broader SAP program team.
You will work in close collaboration with the Technical Lead and contribute to the delivery of migration pipelines across all in-scope data objects, in an agile delivery mode with iterative development and
regular validation cycles.
By joining us, you will play a hands-on role in one of the most technically challenging phases of a major international transformation program.
 Your mission will include :
 Designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines for data extraction, transformation, and loading
 Implementing transformation rules based on mapping specifications defined with the Technical Lead
 Participating in data quality checks, reconciliation processes, and error handling
 Documenting pipeline logic, transformation rules, and technical decisions
 Contributing to the continuous improvement of delivery practices within the squad
 What You Bring
 Senior Data Engineer
 2–4 years of experience in data engineering or ETL-focused roles
 Comfortable implementing pipelines based on defined specifications
 Eager to grow in a structured migration context
 ETL & Data Engineering
 Solid hands-on experience with at least one ETL platform (Talend, Informatica, SSIS, or equivalent)
 Strong understanding of data transformation patterns and pipeline design
 Experience working with large and complex datasets
 Familiarity with data quality concepts — validation rules, rejection handling, reconciliation
 Soft Skills
 Rigorous and detail-oriented approach to delivery
 Ability to work collaboratively in a small, fast-moving team
 Good communication skills — able to discuss technical topics with both engineers and functional stakeholders
 NICE TO HAV E
Exposure to SAP data structures or SAP migration projects
Familiarity with SAP migration tools (BODS, Syniti/SNP, or equivalent)
Experience working in an agile delivery environment
Knowledge of cloud-based data platforms (Azure, GCP, AWS)
 YOUR CAREER AT THALES
 Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your competencies in different areas:
Room and attention to personal development
Build your talents in another domain of Thales Group, discovering new products, new customers, new country or go to a more complex Solution
Choose between a technical expertise or a leadership path
Build an international career within a leading Engineering Group
